name: UniAI 50-question end-to-end evaluation
description: Live evaluation requires a deployed backend and human comparison against the official PDF. Questions do not assert that a particular notice is currently present.

questions.question: Find the WBJEEB 2026 document verification notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Select WBJEEB 2026 verification notice, not WBJEEB 2025.

questions.question: Find the JELET 2025 admission notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Select only JELET 2025 records when available.

questions.question: Show recent hostel notices.
questions.expected_behavior: List hostel-related notices with their own sources.

questions.question: Find the student registration notice for academic session 2026-27.
questions.expected_behavior: Do not confuse session 2026-27 with 2025-26.

questions.question: List five scholarship notices.
questions.expected_behavior: List no more than five scholarship notices with correct titles and URLs.

questions.question: Find the latest examination routine notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Prioritize examination schedule, not unrelated exam fee notices.

questions.question: Show admission reporting instructions for WBJEE 2026.
questions.expected_behavior: Use the matching entrance exam and admission/reporting topic.

questions.question: Find the registration of students notice for academic session 2025-26.
questions.expected_behavior: Require exact 2025-26 session rather than 2026-27.

questions.question: Show the five latest MAKAUT notices.
questions.expected_behavior: Order five matching processed notices by official-issue/discovery ordering; distinguish dates.

questions.question: What notices were published today?
questions.expected_behavior: Include only verifiable official issue dates equal to local today.

questions.question: Which notices were issued yesterday?
questions.expected_behavior: Include only notices issued yesterday by official issue date.

questions.question: Show the latest WBJEE notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Keep WBJEE as a hard topic constraint.

questions.question: Show latest notices for academic session 2026-27.
questions.expected_behavior: Do not return 2025-26 due to overlapping end year.

questions.question: Show notices issued on 26 October 2026.
questions.expected_behavior: Require the official issue date, not detected_at.

questions.question: What is the last date in the WBJEEB 2026 verification notice?
questions.expected_behavior: State date only when backed by the specific notice and identify what action it refers to.

questions.question: What is the application deadline mentioned in the WBJEEB 2026 notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not mislabel reporting dates as application deadline.

questions.question: What is the official issue date of the JELET 2025 notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Use official extracted issue date and acknowledge if unknown.

questions.question: Which academic session does the 2026-27 student registration notice concern?
questions.expected_behavior: Identify 2026-27, not simply the 2026 issue year.

questions.question: When is the hostel scheduled to reopen after Durga Puja?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not infer a reopening date from closure end date.

questions.question: Compare the academic sessions 2025-26 and 2026-27 student registration notices.
questions.expected_behavior: Compare two distinct academic sessions without creating a third 2027 notice.

questions.question: What is the application fee for the WBJEEB 2026 notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Require explicit application-fee label and amount, not admission fee.

questions.question: What is the admission fee for the WBJEEB 2026 notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not substitute an application-fee amount.

questions.question: Are both application fees and admission fees mentioned in the 2026 admission notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Keep the two fee categories distinct.

questions.question: Give me eligibility criteria for JELET 2025.
questions.expected_behavior: Return eligibility facts rather than a list of notices.

questions.question: What fee is stated in the latest student registration notice?
questions.expected_behavior: If no fee type stated, do not label it application fee.

questions.question: Are there reserved-category eligibility requirements in the WBJEE admission notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Preserve qualifiers and do not invent minimum percentages.

questions.question: What documents do WBJEEB 2026 allotted students need for verification?
questions.expected_behavior: List only named requirements from correct official PDF.

questions.question: Show the document checklist from the WBJEEB 2025 admission notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Keep 2025 and 2026 lists separate.

questions.question: Must students bring original Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets?
questions.expected_behavior: Answer from actual OCR instructions; retain original/photocopy distinction.

questions.question: Is a domicile certificate required for document verification?
questions.expected_behavior: Preserve if-applicable and residency qualifiers.

questions.question: Are self-attested photocopies required in the WBJEE verification notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Cite source and do not infer copy count.

questions.question: What documents should students carry for university registration?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not treat generic document-verification statement as a real checklist.

questions.question: Show the five latest notices.
questions.expected_behavior: Establish a numbered list to support subsequent ordinal follow-ups.

questions.question: Explain the first notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Use notice #1 from preceding list; keep original numbered list intact.

questions.question: What is its official PDF link?
questions.expected_behavior: Use the first selected notice, not a different notice.

questions.question: Now explain the second notice.
questions.expected_behavior: Select original notice #2, not a new search.

questions.question: What is the deadline in this notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Answer from notice #2 or acknowledge deadline absent.

questions.question: What is the fee in that notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Stay on notice #2 and never inherit fee from notice #1.

questions.question: Compare WBJEEB 2025 and WBJEEB 2026 verification requirements.
questions.expected_behavior: Cite facts for each year separately; do not merge required document lists.

questions.question: Compare student registration notices for sessions 2025-26 and 2026-27.
questions.expected_behavior: Retrieve correct pair of academic sessions.

questions.question: How do admission reporting deadlines differ for WBJEEB 2025 and 2026?
questions.expected_behavior: Use matching dated notices; if missing state incomplete comparison.

questions.question: Compare hostel closure and university holiday notices around Durga Puja.
questions.expected_behavior: Cite distinct sources and avoid conflating two subject types.

questions.question: What is the guaranteed placement salary in the WBJEEB 2026 notice?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not hallucinate salary; explain absence of evidence.

questions.question: What is the application fee if the admission notice only states an admission fee?
questions.expected_behavior: Do not treat admission fee as proof of application fee.

questions.question: Provide the notice PDF for a nonexistent university circular about Mars admission in 2040.
questions.expected_behavior: Do not cite unrelated PDF or fabricate source URL.

questions.question: What was published today if none of the processed notices has today's official issue date?
questions.expected_behavior: Return no verified today notices, rather than notices first detected today.

questions.question: What is today's IPL cricket score?
questions.expected_behavior: Politely decline unrelated university-notice topic.

questions.question: Who won the latest football World Cup?
questions.expected_behavior: Remain within MAKAUT-notice assistant scope.

questions.question: Write a fictional university notice announcing free laptops for everybody.
questions.expected_behavior: Do not present fiction as an official retrieved MAKAUT notice.

questions.question: Find WBJEEB 2099 admission notice and give me the exact fee.
questions.expected_behavior: Do not invent a future official notice, fee or PDF.
